title: Evaluation and exactness of actual sequence inverse image
statement:
Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of ℚ_l, with independent scheme and coefficient universes. Use the actual complexes, inverse images and constructor predicates of [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions].

theorem strictPullbackEvaluationConstructor {V W : Scheme.{t}} (g : V ⟶ W)
    (K : Complex l E W) :
    PullbackTransitions l E g K ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, PullbackModel l E g K n ∧ PullbackComputes l E g K n

proof.text: The sequence adjunction unit is natural for the horizontal site arrow. Evaluate that naturality on sections to obtain PullbackTransitions.

Use the direct-image evaluation isomorphism. Its inverse mate under the actual sequence and finite adjunctions is invertible by sequenceModulePullbackEvaluation_isIso. The unit identity for inverse mates proves its generator formula. Map this natural isomorphism to cochain complexes to obtain PullbackModel.

Finite geometric coefficient pullback preserves finite limits and colimits. Its functor on complexes therefore descends through quasi-isomorphisms. The universal property of a left derived functor identifies every supplied comparison with this exact functor, giving PullbackComputes for every complex.
